topic.title: Working as a Contributor
topic.shortdesc: Contributors use to propose changes to the content of a project. They edit the project files in their own personal workspace and send their changes to the project team as a review task.

body.p: This section describes the main tasks available to users with the Contributor platform user role in .
With the Contributor platform user role, you can only have the Collaborator project role in a project. A project owner adds you to a project as a Collaborator.

As a Collaborator, you can read the project content and edit it in your own personal workspace. You cannot change the project content directly. To suggest your changes, create a review task from them. A member of the project team then takes the task, reviews your changes, and decides which ones to integrate into the project.

Contributors can also perform all the tasks that users with the Subject-Matter Expert platform user role can perform, such as reviewing content that others share with them and creating their own independent review tasks.

ul.li: Open the projects they were added to and read their content.
Edit the project files in a personal workspace.
Propose their changes to the project team by creating a review task from them.
Take part in the review of the changes they proposed.
Review content shared with them and create independent review tasks.

section.title: What Contributors Cannot Do
section.p: Contributors do not have the project management capabilities that users with the Author platform user role have. As a Contributor, you cannot:

ul.li: Commit your changes to the project.
Create projects, or manage project settings and members.
Integrate a review task into the project.

section.title: How to Use This Section
section.p: Start with Projects for Contributors to understand what you can access in a project.
Next, see Working in Your Personal Workspace and Suggesting Changes to a Project, which describe the main Contributor workflow.
To find out how your proposal is handled by the project team, see After You Suggest Changes.

section.title: Resources
section.p: For a short presentation about the Contributor role, see Video: Expert Contributions in Oxygen Content Fusion.
